item.title: Governing multi-system innovation: A policy mix on its emergence, co-evolution, and diffusion
item.content:encoded:
This special issue is focused on innovation governance through policy mixes. Policy mixes are combinations of different policy instruments aimed at governing innovation across multiple systems. The special issue welcomes research that examines how policy mixes emerge, co-evolve, and diffuse across different contexts and innovation systems.
